title: Resolve Routes.meetingPresences stub — either remove route or implement MeetingPresencesCubit
objective: Decide on a single direction for the stubbed MeetingPresences route: either remove the route from the router entirely (and from Routes.meetingPresences, since no caller invokes it), or implement MeetingPresencesCubit so it at minimum loads presences for the meetingId passed in the route path.
description: lib/routing/router.dart (lines 327-333) registers `GoRoute(path: Routes.meetingPresences, builder: ... MeetingPresencesScreen())` with a TO-DO comment. MeetingPresencesCubit (lib/ui/meeting_presences/cubit/meeting_presences_cubit.dart, 11 lines) is empty — no methods, no fields. MeetingPresencesScreen is the only thing rendered. Search the codebase for any caller of Routes.meetingPresences or context.push('/meeting-presences') — if no caller exists, the route is dead code and the fix is to delete the GoRoute, the MeetingPresencesScreen, the MeetingPresencesCubit, the MeetingPresencesState, and Routes.meetingPresences itself. If a caller DOES exist (search lib/ui/ for context.push/pop matching the path), the fix is to implement MeetingPresencesCubit with at minimum a loadPresences(meetingId) method that delegates to IMeetingPresencesRepository.getByMeetingId and emits Loaded/Error states. Either way, the fix is binary — no half-measures.

reference_files.reason: The stubbed GoRoute. REWRITE — either delete or pass an IMeetingPresencesRepository provider to MeetingPresencesCubit.
Routes.meetingPresences constant — DELETE if removing, KEEP if implementing.
Empty cubit. REWRITE — implement loadPresences(meetingId) if keeping the route; DELETE otherwise.
State class — KEEP if implementing; DELETE otherwise (along with its .freezed.dart sibling if any).
Screen — KEEP if implementing; DELETE otherwise.

decision_steps: 1. Run `rg -n 'meeting-presences|meetingPresences|Routes.meetingPresences' lib/` and inspect every match.
2. If only the router registration and the stub cubit appear, no caller exists → REMOVE branch.
3. If any UI file pushes to '/meeting-presences' or references Routes.meetingPresences, the route is live → IMPLEMENT branch.

remove_branch: Delete the entire GoRoute block from lib/routing/router.dart lines 327-333
Delete the Routes.meetingPresences constant from lib/routing/routes.dart line 31
Remove the import in router.dart (line 26) for meeting_presences_screen
fix_shapes.implement_branch: Rewrite MeetingPresencesCubit to accept IMeetingPresencesRepository in its constructor and expose loadPresences(int meetingId) that emits Initial → Loading → Loaded(list) or Error(message). Update MeetingDetailsScreen route registration to pass an IMeetingPresencesRepository provider (it already has one — line 223 of router.dart).

acceptance_criteria: Either the entire MeetingPresences feature is deleted (no orphan files, no dead routes, no empty cubit) OR it is fully implemented with a working loadPresences(meetingId) method
lib/routing/router.dart no longer contains a GoRoute with the // TO-DO comment
lib/routing/routes.dart no longer declares Routes.meetingPresences if the REMOVE branch was chosen
If IMPLEMENT was chosen: MeetingPresencesCubit.loadPresences(int meetingId) emits a Loaded state on success and an Error state on failure — verified by code inspection
If IMPLEMENT was chosen: the cubit is wired to IMeetingPresencesRepository in router.dart (BlocProvider or constructor injection)
No unused imports survive — verified by flutter analyze

grep_evidence: rg -n 'TO-DO: Implement MeetingPresencesCubit' lib/ must return zero matches

rg -n 'MeetingPresencesCubit|MeetingPresencesScreen|meetingPresences' lib/ should match only live references — if REMOVE was chosen, all references vanish except potentially inside lib/routing/router.dart (must be zero); if IMPLEMENT was chosen, only router.dart + the cubit + the screen

no_op_outside_scope: Do not touch the existing MeetingDetailsCubit.loadPresences (lines 68-96 of meeting_details_cubit.dart) — that one already works correctly. Do not change IMeetingPresencesRepository or its concrete impl — they are correct.
